name: PM Awas Yojana (PMAY 2.0)
summary: Housing scheme offering interest subsidy on home loans and direct assistance to help Economically Weaker Section, Low Income, and Middle Income families buy or build a home.
eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS): household income up to ₹3 lakh/year
Middle Income Group (MIG): ₹6-18 lakh/year, eligible for a smaller subsidy slab
Applicant or family should not already own a pucca house anywhere in India
documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Property documents (for construction/enhancement) or builder-buyer agreement (for purchase)
fee: No application fee. Benefit is an interest subsidy of up to ₹1.8 lakh (roughly ₹36,000/year for 5 years under the Credit-Linked Subsidy Scheme) rather than a cash grant.
process: Check eligibility and income category on the PMAY-Urban portal
Register with Aadhaar and complete the online application form
Upload income, identity, and property/loan documents
Application is verified by the Urban Local Body / lending bank
Subsidy is credited directly to the home loan account upon approval

faq.question: Is PMAY a cash grant?
faq.answer: For most urban applicants it's an interest subsidy on a home loan, credited upfront to reduce the effective loan amount — not a direct cash payout. Total assistance typically works out to roughly ₹1.5-2.5 lakh depending on income category and loan size.

faq.question: Can I apply if I already own land but no house?
faq.answer: Yes — owning land without a pucca house doesn't disqualify you; the scheme covers both construction on owned land and purchase of a new home.
